steps: Fill the existing deposit field with 25.
Activate Put in $100; read the actual input property as 100 and selected Deposit tab.
Select Redeem and In kind; inspect the changed explanatory text without connecting or signing.
Use Enter on bottom-navigation controls to open Portfolio, Create, Privacy and Demo setup; inspect focus, headings and overflow.
checks.observed: Preparation reset the input to 100. Both withdrawal views and existing routes worked. No wallet connection, approval, deposit or other transaction was initiated by the agent.

intentionalDepartures: Keep real Feeds: Chainlink / Receiver: simulation disclosure rather than the generated image’s inaccurate Funds/Receipts labels.
Preserve existing licensed DM Sans and Manrope fonts, actual chain data, fees and controls. No generated balance or claim is used in the app.
Use the existing 216px sidebar and existing content instead of claiming a pixel-identical reproduction.
Keep testnet, mock, unaudited, public-holdings and stale-fee disclosures visible.
limitations: Read-only disconnected-wallet UI checks only; signed transaction, CRE execution, full privacy acceptance, physical touch and full accessibility conformance are not established.
One real HTTP read error was captured, then a single reload recovered; no pin change or public fallback was made. Extension listener warnings are retained in browser-observations.json.

Viewport capability calls did not resize existing tabs. Temporary same-origin fixed-size frames supplied measured content viewports; harness copies retained here, removed from the product before committing.
